known_prior_results: Prior burden study contained body linear and nuisance quadratic terms but did not test body-change or body-optimum questions. Exposures and sample counts inspected before this plan; no new outcome effects inspected.
sources: Immutable weight_speed_v2 source and pair lineage, original quality CSV and T-2 history, read-only local DB only for current profile names and full result body chronology. Official horse IDs; preserve excluded-horse rules.
population: 52,155 strict normal complete-rank starts, 7-13 runners, positive body and burden; all current distances. Same 27,230 eligible same-horse/exact-distance/year/grade 7-60-day endpoint pairs. Sex from race event; geldings separate. Exclude female-versus-male/gelding history conflicts only from sex-specific inference; preserve all rows in pooled analyses.
body_change: Primary change is endpoint measured body difference in exact-distance pairs, not printed parentheses. Printed previous-start change separately audited against all observed result chronology; never assumed previous exact-distance change.
pair_primary: Separate unpenalized positive gain/10kg and positive loss/10kg terms. Controls burden increase/decrease, previous burden, previous body/10 and square, prior relative time/finish/history, gap, event age, field change, moisture-band and gate differences, two annual harmonics, year-grade. Nuisance standardized ridge1, intercept unpenalized. Targets seconds difference and 100log time ratio.
pair_sensitivity: full same-month same-moisture-band and burden change <=1kg, no restriction on body change; full without prior-performance controls. Joint sex gain/loss slopes with direct female-minus-male tests; same event sex at both endpoints.
row_curve: Distance-specific race+horse FE, body/10 and its square unpenalized; controls burden, T-2 same-distance recent times/finish, log starts/gaps, event age and square, gate and event sex. Absolute curve centered278kg. Sensitivity no-history and body relative to full-period horse median (retrospective only). Joint sex-specific linear and quadratic terms, direct female-minus-male 2df test.
optimum_reporting: Vertex only a quadratic association candidate, never physiological optimum. Require positive curvature, 95% curvature lower bound>0, BH curvature q<.05, vertex in group body10th-90th percentiles, at least10% observations on each side, and 95% vertex simulation interval inside 5th-95th percentiles. 10,000 coefficient-normal covariance draws; condition on positive curvature and explicitly report positive fraction. Require consistent recent-period candidate before calling repeated.
individual: Train-shape period2017-2023, later-shape period2024-2026partial. Separately fit global body-omitted nuisance/horse/race FE in each period; residuals provide retrospective performance adjustment, not future prediction. Horse-by-exact-distance train>=30 starts, >=8 unique body masses, span>=20kg. Fit residual quadratic with HC1, require curvature BH q<.05, interior10th-90th vertex and >=5 starts each side. Later support>=15 starts, >=6 unique masses, span>=15kg; later positive curvature BH q<.05 and interior vertex within5kg of train vertex for repeated candidate. All eligible support and coefficients saved. Pooled later far>=10kg versus near<=5kg train-vertex residual contrast secondary, groups>=5 each per candidate, date+horse uncertainty.
uncertainty: Conservative date covariance plus horse covariance without intersection subtraction, t df smaller cluster count, FE absorbed df. Pair later endpoint date clustering limitation. Individual HC1 exploratory, small samples and survival/sex transitions noted.
multiplicity: BH across distances and both outcomes by pair period/variant/exposure; row curvature by period/variant/sex and both outcomes; female-minus-male joint shape tests by period across distances and outcomes; individual train curvature over all eligible horse-distance cells, later over all later-supported eligible cells.
inference_limits: Retrospective repeated-use development comparisons, no independent validation or causal body effect. Growing/aging horses, fitness, disease, feeding, selection and measurement variation remain. Body at current race is explanatory, not T-2 available. No fixed optimum or operational model update. 2026partial explicit. Unsupported1610 and small sex-distance cells suppressed.
